r13.exp: 'NEWLY WED, the Owenses organized an auction' = bili su upravo vjenčani = D (were already married).

r14.exp: 'Sold their possessions, and used the proceeds to buy camping equipment and PLANE TICKETS' = novac od prodaje imovine = C.

r15.exp: 'Wildlife had NOT BEEN REDUCED BY POACHING' = bogata fauna netaknuta krivolovom = D (wildlife was abundant there).

r16.exp: 'Our major concern was having to RATION OURSELVES TO SEVEN GALLONS' = količina vode = B.

r17.exp: 'By writing about the exploits of these predators... they attracted... FUNDING' = pisali su o hjenama i dobili financiranje = C.

r18.exp: 'I LAND in the grass' — ideal day starts with flying and landing = A (flying an airplane).

r19.exp: 'Personalities under attack from various sources. (19)___. And this involves hard work.' → D: It is crucial to become one's own person and separate oneself from these negative influences.

r20.exp: 'Need to eliminate negative thoughts. (20)___. ONE involves voice therapy.' → F: To accomplish this task, there are several methods that can be used. 'One' refers back to 'several methods'.

r21.exp: 'Another turns them into constructive thoughts. (21)___. Only then can we start expressing our own point of view.' → H: This technique also includes identifying the sources of one's destructive thoughts.

r22.exp: 'Man troubled by repeating father's words. (22)___. They were absolutely sure they never would.' → G: Many people are surprised that they are acting in the very same way their parents did.

r23.exp: 'Cling to out-dated way, emotionally trapped. (23)___. Also need to give up hope of finding love we missed as children.' → B: They often react to their partner from this defensive or childlike point of view.

r24.exp: 'Need to develop our own values. (24)___. This is the only way to resist society.' → C: If we don't, we won't be able to live a life of integrity, according to our own personal criteria.

r25.exp: 'Suffer SEVERE sleep deprivation' — kolokacija: severe deprivation = ozbiljno nedostajanje sna.

r26.exp: 'EVEN before the change, teenagers were getting less sleep' — 'even' za naglašavanje iznenađujuće informacije.

r27.exp: 'Something teenagers are FAMILIAR with' — fiksna kolokacija: be familiar with = biti upoznat s, znati.

r28.exp: 'Quite RESILIENT... amazing ability to BOUNCE BACK' — 'resilient' = otporan, koji se brzo oporavlja (bounce back = oporaviti se).

r29.exp: 'These (wristwatches) were WORN constantly' — 'wear' za nošenje odjeće/nakita/satova.

r30.exp: 'Less than six hours of sleep A night' — distributivni član 'a' = po noći (per night).

r31.exp: 'Happen AT the same time every day' — prijedlog 'at' za točno određeno vrijeme.

r32.exp: 'This MEANS teenagers are awake later' — 'mean' = znači, ima za posljedicu (logička posljedica). 'Causes' bi tražilo 'to be'.

r33.exp: 'ON a collision course with the Earth' — fiksna kolokacija: be on a collision course = biti na putu sudaranja.

r34.exp: 'Do very LITTLE damage' — 'little' uz nebrojivu imenicu (damage = nebroj.) za malu količinu.

r35.exp: 'Heard WHAT sounded like an explosion' — 'what' u ugrađenoj surečenici: what = that which (ono što).

r36.exp: 'ACCORDING to a Reuters correspondent' — fiksni izraz: according to = prema (izvoru informacije).

r37.exp: 'Travelling AT a speed of 30 km per second' — fiksna kolokacija: travel at a speed of = putovati brzinom od.

r38.exp: 'A trail that COULD be seen as far as 200 km' — 'could' za mogućnost u prošlosti (was visible).

r39.exp: 'Car alarms went OFF' — frazalni glagol: go off = oglasiti se (o alarmima/zvukovima).

r40.exp: 'In the geologically NOT so distant past' — 'not so distant' = nije tako davno (geološki gledano).

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA: lakša komunikacija, dostupnost za pitanja, bolje razumijevanje, moderan odnos. PROTIV: narušavanje granica, nespretni privatni sadržaji, gubitak autoriteta nastavnika, profesionalnost. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (for and against + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
